messages:
maya: Quick proposal — run a 20m "Activation Spark" demo that bundles a 120-token starter credit + 4 focused prompts (summarize, extract-intent, FAQ-boiler, template-rewrite). Tiny benchmark vignette in slides. Goal: raise first-request -> activation within 8h by ~15%.

jordan: Love compact format. Primary metric = activated within 8h. Secondaries = prompt_pack adoption, median latency for the 4 starter prompts, 24h retention.

bex (growth-eng): Routing plan: A/B test SDR handoff vs instant self-serve. Rule draft: company_size>75 or enterprise_domain => SDR, else auto. I can add feature flag for the A/B.

samir: Measurement notes — tag signups utm=activation_spark, cohort=spark_may. Events: spark_signup, starter_credit_granted, prompt_pack_used, first_api_request, activated, converted_30d. Dashboard: 0-8h hourly, 24h follow-ups.

olivia: Landing microcopy: "Activation Spark — 120 free tokens + 4 ready prompts. Try a short benchmark live." Keep it punchy and product-led. Also add a 24h micro-survey: 2 quick questions + one free-text for blockers.

bex (growth-eng): For auto flow: immediate email with credit + in-console pack and a contextual nudge at first API call linking to a one-page benchmark. For SDR flow: tag lead for follow-up and send a 24h reminder if no activation.

maya: Slide bench placeholder: "Starter summarize median latency ~210ms — est cost $0.018 per 1k tokens" (will update after smoke runs). I'll prepare slides + one-pager by Tue EOD.

launch-bot: Calendar event created  Activation Spark demo Thu 09:00. :calendar: 

maya: Timeline: landing + routing up Wed AM, dry-run Wed 17:00, live Thu. Quick pre-launch sync Wed 15m.

jordan: Also add tracking for prompt_qa_complaint and error_rate so we can catch regressions fast.

everyone: +1
